grammar.title: 语法知识 宾语从句：句子作宾语
lines: 8 宾语从句的结构 结论1：主句为“一般现在”，从句可以任意时态。 宾语从句的功能：表达观点 I think (that) … 我觉得 I believe (that) … 我相信
主 谓 宾
I love you.
think he is awful.
主句 引导词 从句
I think that he is awful. (主系表)
She says (一般现在) he loved her. (一般过去)
He knows (一般现在) she has gone . (现在完成)
He is sorry (一般现在) he will leave . (一般将来)
I know (that) he will watch the movie . 我知道他会看电影的。
I know (that) he has watched the movie . 我知道他已经看电影了。
I know (that) he usually watches the movie . 我知道他经常看电影。
I know (that) he is watching the movie . 我知道他正在看电影。
I think (that) it is very good .
Because we learn about what the PM2.5 is and what we must do .

expand.title: 扩展知识 slip 详解
lines: 3 slip [slɪp] v. 滑倒 sli pper s n. 拖鞋 每日习语 you bet = certainly 当然了、肯定了
It slips my mind. 我给忘记了。
That was only a slip of the pen . 那不过是笔误而已。
She accidentally said the wrong name, it was just a slip of the tongue . 她不小心说错了名字，那只是一次口误。
Put on your slippers . 把拖鞋穿上。
